negatives.observed_failure: Two broad exact-keyword searches of the large memory registry exceeded their bounded timeouts before a narrower identity search succeeded.
negatives.recovery: Retain both timeouts, use the narrowest current task-group query, and rely on memory for method only after live repository verification.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; timed-out memory searches supplied no current-state claim

negatives.observed_failure: WindowsSandbox.exe was absent and the optional-feature status query required elevation.
negatives.recovery: Record the audit as unavailable, do not elevate or change a feature, and use ordinary fresh detached D-drive snapshots.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; no Sandbox execution or host-isolation assurance is claimed

negatives.observed_failure: A bounded ripgrep duplicate-source query returned exit code one because none of the candidate source titles appeared in the inherited source ledgers.
negatives.recovery: Retain the no-match wrapper result as an operational negative and separately inspect the inherited chain before assigning new source identifiers.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; absence from that one search is not proof of global novelty

negatives.observed_failure: The unadapted current-checkout suite passed 499 of 500 tests and failed the inherited CRLF-sensitive legacy constraint-hash alias fixture.
negatives.recovery: Retain the failed run, use the inherited semantic-hash-verified materializer inside a byte-restoring wrapper, rerun all 500 tests, and restore both inherited raw byte sequences before counting success.
negatives.promotion_effect: the 499-of-500 run remains failed evidence; only a complete restored rerun may satisfy the x1 repository gate

boundary: Recovered failures remain negatives and are not counted as successful evidence runs.
